source_snapshot.criteria: Bandwidth is about 90% of ideal value.

old_problem: The active record treated `ib_write_bw` in Ethernet mode as an unresolved RoCE-versus-iperf decision. NVIDIA explicitly recommends ib_write_bw as a low-level RoCE communication/bandwidth test and requires the correct RoCE GID path. Because the Master names ib_write_bw, changing to iperf would alter coverage; the authoritative interpretation is RoCE over the Ethernet link.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA documentation establishes that ib_write_bw is valid over RoCE and LINK_TYPE_P1=2 selects Ethernet. ED-05 keeps this Ethernet/RoCE case separate from InfiniBand row439; ED-03 permits GID/IP/fabric/profile bindings; ED-06/ED-18 preserve the DC cycle; ED-15 requires a negotiated-link payload ideal and 90% oracle; ED-20 forbids replacing the literal verbs test with native TCP bandwidth.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row440 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3030 and adjacent row439 IB bandwidth plus row441 distinct inconsistent-unit IB variant.
Applied NVIDIA LINK_TYPE semantics: P1 value 2 activates Ethernet after reboot/cycle.
Applied NVIDIA RoCE guidance that ib_write_bw is a valid low-level two-node RoCE test and that correct RoCE v2 GID selection is essential.
Preserved the source's ib_write_bw, -F, bidirectional -b, --report_gbits, port 3000, /24 addressing and 90% target; iperf is not substituted.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row441 and verified its manifest identity; no mlxconfig, DC cycle, Ethernet/RoCE configuration, traffic or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Mellanox P1 Ethernet-mode RoCE activation and finite paired ib_write_bw 90%-of-ideal validation
test_case.purpose: Activate the exact approved port in Ethernet mode through the required DC cycle, prove a valid RoCE path, and measure finite bidirectional verbs bandwidth against a negotiated-link, unit-correct 90%-of-ideal floor.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA MFT/firmware/OFED or rdma-core/perftest versions with RoCE support
Adapter serial/MST/BDF/P1/netdev/RDMA-device/GID-index/peer/cable/NUMA map and saved prior LINK_TYPE/network state
Approved Ethernet/RoCE v1 or v2 configuration: IP/subnet/route, MTU, VLAN, FEC, PFC/ECN/traffic class and switch path
Finite ib_write_bw message/QP/depth/duration or iteration/repeat/statistic profile and matched peer versions
Negotiated Ethernet link rate plus approved RoCE payload-ideal formula, units, 90% threshold, OOB/DC-cycle/rollback plan
test_case.test_command: Verify immutable P1/peer identity and save current/next-boot LINK_TYPE plus network/fabric state. At an approved hold point set only `LINK_TYPE_P1=2`, perform the complete DC OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready cycle, and prove active Ethernet link rate, width, FEC, MTU, VLAN and clean counters. Configure only the approved /24 address and verify the intended RoCE GID type/index, route, RDMA device and lossless/congestion policy. Under the approved finite limit run the literal paired ib_write_bw server/client options on port 3000, retaining complete outputs and repeats. Compare the approved statistic to 90% of the negotiated link's RoCE payload ideal, then remove temporary network state and restore the saved mode/fabric configuration with required cycle/post-health.
test_case.expected_result: The exact P1 reports Ethernet active after the full DC cycle and the approved RoCE path resolves to the expected RDMA device/GID/peer with healthy link/fabric counters. Every finite ib_write_bw pair completes with matched parameters and no loss/congestion/error anomaly; the approved throughput statistic is at least 90% of the project-defined RoCE payload ideal. Prior mode/network state is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable identity, before/pending/active mode evidence, complete DC transition, verified Ethernet and RoCE GID/fabric state, exact finite paired outputs, link/error/congestion counters, a documented unit-consistent 90% calculation and restoration. Ethernet link-up alone, TCP iperf, an unproven GID or absent payload formula cannot pass; missing oracle is INCONCLUSIVE.
safety_gate: Never change an unidentified/shared management port; require maintenance, OOB and explicit mode/DC approval
Do not run ib_write_bw until the Ethernet-mode RDMA device, RoCE type/GID/route and switch lossless policy are verified
Bound saturating traffic and abort on link flap, congestion/loss, fabric, thermal or RAS impact
Restore prior mode/network/fabric state, preserve logs and never auto-retry a mutation, cycle or benchmark
expected_evidence: Pinned stack and adapter/P1/netdev/RDMA/GID/peer/NUMA identity plus saved prestate
mlxconfig before/pending/active state and complete DC OFF/ON/OS-ready timeline
Ethernet rate/FEC/MTU/VLAN/IP plus RoCE type/GID/route/PFC/ECN and pre/post counters
Exact finite server/client commands, outputs, exits and repeat statistics
RoCE payload-ideal/90% calculation, restored state and post-health verdict
test_case.recovery: On mode, cycle, GID/fabric or traffic failure, stop the test, preserve state/counters, use OOB to restore the saved LINK_TYPE and network/fabric configuration through the separately approved cycle, and verify manageability/link health. Do not switch to another tool or retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Official NVIDIA guidance resolves the literal Ethernet-mode ib_write_bw method as RoCE; native TCP substitution is excluded and DeepSeek incompleteness is reconciled.

blocked.reason: RoCE transport semantics are authoritative; exact GID/fabric/profile and performance parameters are mandatory runtime/project configuration.
